'''Eyal''' is a man from [[Mat Cauthon]]'s memories.

== History ==
Mat remembers that Eyal fought in the Marches of [[Battle of Maighande|Maighande]].{{ref/book|14|36}}

==Trivia==
* Eyal is named after Eyal Weinstock, a fan of ''The Wheel of Time''.<ref name="thirteenth-depository">Taglieri, Linda. [http://13depository.blogspot.com/2002/02/character-names-derived-from-readers.html Character Names Derived From Readers' Names]</ref>
